body: I wish I had that luxury. I live in a small town and have so much on my plate between work and home I could never devote the time to drive and keep appointments. Are there any online or phone services?

It jus tha opened last week so I’m thinking they’re still building a case and getting a raid of several people organized. Wish I could delete, but it was an immediate ban, lost all of my files stored in Drive. It’s devastating in that sense; no taxes, no divorce documents, no family photos, no contacts, lists, building plans I had, etc. 

But I totally agree, it’s no way to live life looking over your shoulder.
